description: The Bible Commentary: Proverbs-Ezekiel — the English text the Christian Classics Ethereal Library publishes for this work, on the site's Commentaries shelf. historicalContext: Read in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's catalogue, whose shelves follow the site's own division of Christian literature, and whose transcription follows the print edition Grand Rapids, MI: Baker Book House, 1953.
availabilityNote: Complete in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's plain-text edition: 1 chapter(s), 424 paragraph(s), 1,696 words. The text is public domain and is displayed with the library's credit.
